up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records for compound CHEMBL5498743 and its salt/derivative forms tested against target CHEMBL392. Output columns: compound preferred name, compound CHEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, activity standard value, activity standard units, assay description, document title, document year, document DOI. Filter activities by standard_type = 'IC50'. Match the target using target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL392'. Use molecule_hierarchy to find salt/derivative forms where parent_molregno matches the molregno of CHEMBL5498743, and include the parent compound itself. Join compound_structures for canonical SMILES and docs for literature metadata. Do not apply row limits or extra filters on standard_relation, units, or confidence scores.
sql:
WITH target_mols AS (
    SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
    UNION
    SELECT mh.molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    WHERE mh.parent_molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743')
)
SELECT
    md.pref_name,
    md.chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    d.title,
    d.year,
    d.doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN target_mols tm ON md.molregno = tm.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL392'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'

up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records for compound CHEMBL5498743 and its salt/derivative forms tested against target CHEMBL392. Output columns: compound_pref_name (use COALESCE(child_molecule_dictionary.pref_name, parent_molecule_dictionary.pref_name) to ensure salts display the parent's name if they lack one), compound_chembl_id, parent_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation, assay_description, doc_title, doc_year, doc_doi. Logic: 1. Identify parent molregno from molecule_dictionary where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'. 2. Use molecule_hierarchy to find all salts (where parent_molregno matches the parent molregno) and union with the parent molregno itself to get all relevant molregnos. 3. Join this set with molecule_dictionary (aliased as child_md) to get child details. 4. Join molecule_hierarchy (aliased as mh) on the child molregno to retrieve the parent molregno for each record. 5. Join molecule_dictionary again (aliased as parent_md) on the parent molregno to fetch the parent's pref_name and chembl_id. 6. Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50'. 7. Filter assays where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL392'. 8. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles. 9. Join docs for title, year, and doi. Do not apply row limits. Do not filter on confidence_score or doc_type.
sql:
WITH parent_info AS (
    SELECT molregno AS parent_molregno, chembl_id AS parent_chembl_id, pref_name AS parent_pref_name
    FROM molecule_dictionary
    WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
),
all_molregnos AS (
    SELECT parent_molregno AS molregno, parent_molregno AS parent_molregno FROM parent_info
    UNION
    SELECT mh.molregno, mh.parent_molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    JOIN parent_info pi ON mh.parent_molregno = pi.parent_molregno
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(child_md.pref_name, pi.parent_pref_name) AS compound_pref_name,
    child_md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    pi.parent_chembl_id AS parent_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.standard_relation,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    d.title AS doc_title,
    d.year AS doc_year,
    d.doi AS doc_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN all_molregnos amr ON cr.molregno = amr.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary child_md ON cr.molregno = child_md.molregno
JOIN parent_info pi ON amr.parent_molregno = pi.parent_molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL392'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
